name: amazon-listing-pro
title: Amazon listing pro
description: Rewrites an Amazon India or US listing from the seller's own search term report: keyword research by orders and clicks, competitor gaps, a title led by the top search, backend search terms filled to the 249-byte limit, and a before-and-after demand score.
data_policy: Runs on your computer. Your reports and listing never leave it; only the copy you approve goes to your AI model through MangoMan.
